derived_nfrs.title: API time behaviour (p95 latency)
derived_nfrs.statement: The system SHALL respond to mutating + read requests within 50ms (p95) under nominal load.
derived_nfrs.rationale: ISO/IEC 25010:2023 Performance Efficiency / time_behaviour. Derived because the project exposes 73 functional endpoint(s); without a quantified latency target the SRS is unverifiable per Eckhardt 2016.

acceptance_criteria.given: the system is under nominal load (50 concurrent users)
acceptance_criteria.then: p95 response time < 50ms

derived_nfrs.title: Horizontal scalability target
derived_nfrs.statement: The system SHALL sustain 100 RPS sustained throughput with horizontal pod scaling without per-request degradation.
derived_nfrs.rationale: ISO/IEC 25010:2023 Flexibility / scalability. Derived from scale_tier='production'; pilot tier omits this.

acceptance_criteria.given: the system is deployed with replica count >= 2
acceptance_criteria.when: sustained load of 100 RPS is applied for 5 minutes
acceptance_criteria.then: p95 latency stays within performance target with no 5xx errors

derived_nfrs.title: Availability target (99.9%)
derived_nfrs.statement: The system SHALL be available 99.9% measured monthly, excluding documented planned maintenance windows.
derived_nfrs.rationale: ISO/IEC 25010:2023 Reliability / availability. Tier-specific target ('production'); without a quantified target the SLO is unaccountable.

acceptance_criteria.when: external uptime probe queries /health every 60 s for a month
acceptance_criteria.then: recorded availability >= 99.9%

derived_nfrs.title: Downstream-call resilience (circuit breaker + retry)
derived_nfrs.statement: Calls to downstream systems SHALL be wrapped in a circuit breaker with exponential-backoff retry; the system SHALL degrade gracefully and surface a typed error to the caller rather than propagating the underlying failure.
derived_nfrs.rationale: ISO/IEC 25010:2023 Reliability / fault_tolerance. Derived from FRs that touch external systems; without breaker + retry semantics, transient downstream faults cascade.

acceptance_criteria.then: the breaker opens after threshold and a typed error is returned to the caller
the breaker half-opens, probes succeed, and full traffic resumes

derived_nfrs.title: Disaster recovery (RPO 15 min / RTO 1 h)
derived_nfrs.statement: The system SHALL declare and exercise documented RPO 15 min and RTO 1 h via at least an annual DR drill.
derived_nfrs.rationale: ISO/IEC 25010:2023 Reliability / recoverability. Derived from scale_tier='production'.

acceptance_criteria.given: the operator triggers a DR drill
acceptance_criteria.then: failover completes within RTO (1 h) and data loss <= RPO (15 min)

derived_nfrs.title: PHI / PII confidentiality (encryption + redaction)
derived_nfrs.statement: PHI / PII SHALL be encrypted at rest (AES-256 or equivalent) and in transit (TLS 1.2+); PHI SHALL be redacted before any cross-tenant or external sharing.
derived_nfrs.rationale: ISO/IEC 25010:2023 Security / confidentiality. Derived because the FRs touch PHI/PII (markers: []).

acceptance_criteria.given: a record containing PHI is stored
acceptance_criteria.when: the operator inspects the storage layer
acceptance_criteria.then: the record is encrypted at rest

acceptance_criteria.when: user B requests it via any documented endpoint
acceptance_criteria.then: the response is 403 Forbidden and no PHI leaks in error details

derived_nfrs.title: Tamper-evident integrity (hash-chain or signed log)
derived_nfrs.statement: Records that establish accountability (audit log, claim, clinical action) SHALL be tamper-evident via hash-chain or cryptographic signature with periodic anchor publication.
derived_nfrs.rationale: ISO/IEC 25010:2023 Security / integrity. Triggered by audit trail, payment, or clinical-decision domain markers.

acceptance_criteria.given: an entry is appended to the accountability log
acceptance_criteria.when: an attacker mutates a previous entry
acceptance_criteria.then: verification rejects the chain and emits an alertable signal

derived_nfrs.title: Audit trail with correlation ID
derived_nfrs.statement: Every state-changing request SHALL emit an audit-log entry carrying caller identity, timestamp, correlation ID, operation, and outcome.
derived_nfrs.rationale: ISO/IEC 25010:2023 Security / accountability. Required by every regulatory regime that touches accountability.

acceptance_criteria.when: the operator queries the audit log
acceptance_criteria.then: the request appears with caller, ts, correlation_id, operation, and outcome

derived_nfrs.title: Strong authentication on all endpoints
derived_nfrs.statement: All endpoints SHALL require authentication (OIDC JWT or mTLS); credentials SHALL be hashed with a memory-hard KDF (argon2id or bcrypt cost >= 12); JWT TTL <= 24 h.
derived_nfrs.rationale: ISO/IEC 25010:2023 Security / authenticity. Anonymous endpoints are an OWASP A01 (broken access control) risk.

acceptance_criteria.then: the response is 401 Unauthorized

acceptance_criteria.when: the documented login endpoint is invoked
acceptance_criteria.then: a bearer token is returned with TTL <= 24 h

derived_nfrs.title: Rate limiting + abuse defence
derived_nfrs.statement: Public endpoints SHALL apply per-principal rate limiting with documented thresholds; mutating endpoints SHALL honour Idempotency-Key headers; replay attacks within the Idempotency-Key window SHALL be rejected.
derived_nfrs.rationale: ISO/IEC 25010:2023 Security / resistance. OWASP A07.

acceptance_criteria.given: a principal exceeds the documented rate threshold
acceptance_criteria.then: subsequent requests return 429 with Retry-After

derived_nfrs.title: Standard-protocol interoperability
derived_nfrs.statement: External integration SHALL use standard formats: FHIR R4; HL7 v2 / X12 / DICOM (per declared adapter); MCP server manifest + A2A agent card. A current OpenAPI document SHALL be published.
derived_nfrs.rationale: ISO/IEC 25010:2023 Compatibility / interoperability. Bespoke wire formats raise integration cost and lock callers in.

acceptance_criteria.given: an external caller asks for the API contract
acceptance_criteria.then: a current valid OpenAPI 3.x document is returned

derived_nfrs.title: Container co-existence + version pinning
derived_nfrs.statement: The system SHALL ship as a signed container image with pinned base image, no :latest tags, and a published SBOM.
derived_nfrs.rationale: ISO/IEC 25010:2023 Compatibility / coexistence.

acceptance_criteria.given: the operator pulls the released image
acceptance_criteria.when: they inspect the image manifest + SBOM
acceptance_criteria.then: all tags are pinned (no :latest), image is signed (cosign), and an SPDX SBOM is attached

derived_nfrs.title: Multilingual operability (BCP-47)
derived_nfrs.statement: Citizen / patient-facing content SHALL be translatable; language preference SHALL be selectable per BCP-47 tag and respected in all subsequent responses.
derived_nfrs.rationale: ISO/IEC 25010:2023 Interaction Capability / operability.

acceptance_criteria.then: all UI strings render in Swahili (fallback to English only for untranslated keys with explicit warning)

derived_nfrs.title: Modular package layout with public-API surface
derived_nfrs.statement: The codebase SHALL be organised so each top-level concern is a directly-importable package; public API surface SHALL be enumerated in a stable __all__ / public manifest.
derived_nfrs.rationale: ISO/IEC 25010:2023 Maintainability / modularity.

acceptance_criteria.given: a downstream consumer needs only the public API
acceptance_criteria.when: they import only from the documented public surface
acceptance_criteria.then: the import graph never reaches private modules

derived_nfrs.title: Testable component contracts
derived_nfrs.statement: Every public function SHALL be unit-testable without network or filesystem dependencies; integration tests SHALL be invokable in CI without a paid hosted service.
derived_nfrs.rationale: ISO/IEC 25010:2023 Maintainability / testability.

acceptance_criteria.given: the test suite is invoked offline
acceptance_criteria.when: pytest runs with no internet access
acceptance_criteria.then: all unit tests still pass

derived_nfrs.title: OpenTelemetry traces, metrics, logs
derived_nfrs.statement: All entrypoints SHALL emit OpenTelemetry traces, metrics, and structured JSON logs carrying the correlation ID; Prometheus /metrics SHALL be exposed.
derived_nfrs.rationale: ISO/IEC 25010:2023 Maintainability / analysability — covers Observability in the user's NFR list.

acceptance_criteria.when: the operator queries the trace backend by correlation ID
acceptance_criteria.then: a span tree covering the full request is returned

derived_nfrs.title: SemVer + deprecation policy
derived_nfrs.statement: Releases SHALL follow Semantic Versioning; breaking changes SHALL be preceded by a deprecation window of >= 1 minor release with a migration guide.
derived_nfrs.rationale: ISO/IEC 25010:2023 Maintainability / modifiability — covers Extensibility in the user's NFR list.

acceptance_criteria.then: the major version is bumped OR the change went through a deprecation window with a migration guide

derived_nfrs.title: Single-command install + Helm chart parity
derived_nfrs.statement: The system SHALL ship a Helm chart (production deployment) and a docker-compose for local development; both SHALL produce the same runtime contract.
derived_nfrs.rationale: ISO/IEC 25010:2023 Flexibility / installability — covers Portability in the user's NFR list.

acceptance_criteria.given: a fresh operator clones the repo
acceptance_criteria.then: the documented endpoints respond without further configuration

derived_nfrs.title: Clinical-safety hazard log + CSO sign-off
derived_nfrs.statement: A documented hazard log SHALL be maintained; each release SHALL evidence sign-off by a clinical safety officer prior to deployment.
derived_nfrs.rationale: ISO/IEC 25010:2023 Safety / hazard_warning.

acceptance_criteria.then: release is blocked until CSO sign-off + current hazard log are linked

derived_nfrs.title: Confidence threshold + human-in-the-loop fallback
derived_nfrs.statement: Clinical recommendations SHALL declare a confidence threshold below which the response is deferred to a human-in-the-loop reviewer.
derived_nfrs.rationale: ISO/IEC 25010:2023 Safety / fail_safe.

acceptance_criteria.then: a human-in-the-loop escalation is emitted instead of an auto-recommendation
